passive.name: A Promise
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer's memosprite uses Memosprite Skill on one ally, gains "Blank," which increases DMG taken by all enemies by **10/12/14/16/18%**. When the wearer's memosprite uses Memosprite Skill on an enemy, gains "Verse," which increases CRIT DMG of all allies by **16/19/22/25/28%**. When the wearer's memosprite has both "Blank" and "Verse," increases the effects of both "Blank" and "Verse" by **60/65/70/75/80%**.

weapons.name: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

passive.name: Tolerant
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, consumes all allies' HP equal to **1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2%** of their current HP, and after the next attack of the wearer's memosprite, enables it to additionally deal 1 instance of Additional DMG equal to **250/312.5/375/437.5/500%** of the total consumed HP to the attacked target, with the damage type based on the memosprite's type. Then, the total consumed HP is reset. When the wearer's memosprite uses Memosprite Skill, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%**, lasting for **2** turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Gaze
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **12/15/18/21/24%**. When equipped by Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases all ally targets' DMG dealt by **8/10/12/14/16%** and increases the DMG dealt by the Enhanced Basic ATK "Together, We Script Tomorrow!" by **60/70/80/90/100%**.

passive.name: Reception
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **6/7.5/9/10.5/12%**. After the wearer uses Skill, increases the DMG dealt by all allies by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **3** turn(s).

passive.name: Final Hit
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **12/15/18/21/24%**. When the wearer's memosprite uses an ability on an ally target, increases the DMG dealt by all ally targets by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **3** turn(s).

passive.name: Beautify
passive.text: When the wearer summons memosprite for the first time, recovers **1** Skill Point(s) and regenerates **12/14/16/18/20** Energy for this unit.

skillPriority: Memosprite Skill > Memosprite Talent > Talent > Ult = Skill = Basic
tracePriority: Rhapsode's Scepter (A2) > Magnets and Long Chains (A6) > Petite Parable (A4)

entries.name: Leave It to Me!
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Together, We Script Tomorrow!
entries.text: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel all Crowd Control debuffs on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a Joint ATK, dealing Ice DMG to all enemies equal to **120%** of Trailblazer's ATK and **120%** of Mem's ATK respectively. Then, Mem gains **10%** Charge.

entries.name: I Choose You!
entries.text: Summons the memosprite Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP by an amount equal to **60%** of Mem's Max HP, and grants Mem **10%** Charge.

entries.name: Together, Mem!
entries.text: Summons memosprite Mem. Grants Mem **40%** Charge, then makes Mem deal Ice DMG equal to **240%** of Mem's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Almighty Companion
entries.text: Memosprite Mem has an initial SPD of **130** and a Max HP equal to **80%** of Trailblazer's Max HP plus **640**. For every **10** Energy regenerated by all allies in total, Mem gains 1% Charge.

entries.name: Memories Back as Echoes
entries.text:
After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for **10** second(s). Enemies within the Special Dimension are placed in a Time Stop state, halting all their actions.
After entering battle against enemies afflicted with the Time Stop state, delays the action of all enemies by **50%**, and then deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to **100%** of Trailblazer's ATK.
Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

entries.name: Baddies! Trouble!
entries.text: Deals **4** instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Ice DMG equal to **36%** of Mem's ATK to one random enemy. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to **90%** of Mem's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Lemme! Help You!
entries.text:
Advances the action of one designated ally by **100%** and grants them "Mem's Support," lasting for **3** turn(s).
For every 1 instance of DMG dealt by a target that has "Mem's Support," additionally deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to **28%** of the original DMG.
When using this ability on this unit, cannot trigger the action advance effect.

entries.name: Friends! Together!
entries.text:
Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by an amount equal to **12%** of Mem's CRIT DMG plus **24%**.
If the Charge has yet to reach 100%, Mem automatically uses "Baddies! Trouble!" when taking action. When the Charge reaches 100%, Mem immediately takes action. In the next action, can select one ally and use "Lemme! Help You!".

entries.name: Go, Mem, Go!
entries.text: When Mem is summoned, immediately gains **50%** Charge.

entries.name: No... Regrets
entries.text: When Mem disappears, Trailblazer's action advances by **25%**.

entries.name: Rhapsode's Scepter
entries.text: When the battle starts, Trailblazer's action advances by **30%**. When Mem is first summoned, grants Mem **40%** Charge.

entries.name: Petite Parable
entries.text: When using "Baddies! Trouble!," Mem immediately gains **5%** Charge.

entries.name: Magnets and Long Chains
entries.text: When the Max Energy of an ally target that has "Mem's Support" exceeds **100**, for every **10** excess Energy, additionally increases the multiplier of the True DMG dealt via "Mem's Support" by **2%**, up to a max increase of **20%**.

entries.name: Unfinished Epilogue
entries.text: After using Ultimate, gains 1 stack of "Epic," up to **2** stacks. When this unit has "Epic" and Mem is on the field, Basic ATK gets enhanced to "Together, We Script Tomorrow!"

entries.name: Narrator of the Present
entries.text: Increases the CRIT Rate of ally targets with "Mem's Support" by 10%. When an ally target has "Mem's Support," the effect of "Mem's Support" also applies to the target's memosprite/memomaster. This effect cannot stack.

entries.name: Gleaner of the Past
entries.text: When ally memosprites (aside from Mem) take action, Trailblazer regenerates 8 Energy. This effect can trigger a max of 1 time(s) per turn. The trigger count resets at the start of Trailblazer's turn.

entries.name: Chanter of the Future
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Dancer of the Muse
entries.text: When an ally target with 0 Max Energy actively uses an ability, Mem can also gain 3% Charge, and the multiplier of the True DMG dealt by this target via "Mem's Support" additionally increases by 6%.

entries.name: Seamster of the Ode
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Bearer of the Revelation
entries.text: Ultimate's CRIT Rate is set at 100%.
